instruction: RF Front-End Chain Along a Straight Line The file design.kicad_pcb contains eight RF blocks scattered on the PCB. Start KiCad with `/usr/bin/kicad`; the board and schematic editors are also available directly at `/usr/bin/pcbnew` and `/usr/bin/eeschema`. The board connectivity defines their chain order from the stage tied to RF_IN to the stage tied to RF_DATA. Reposition the eight components into a single horizontal row that follows that chain, then write the result as /home/user/Desktop/answer.kicad_pcb. Requirements: 1. All 8 components must be placed such that all their Y coordinates are within +/-0.5 mm of the mean Y of the group. 2. X coordinates must be strictly increasing in the inferred signal order. 3. Centre-to-centre spacing between adjacent components must be at least 6 mm. 4. All rotation angles must be multiples of 90 deg. 5. No component may be rotated exactly 180 deg (connector polarity preservation). 6. No component may be added or removed. Write /home/user/Desktop/answer.kicad_pcb.
